forClients.cards.0.1: Di le dɔ ƒuƒoƒo, didi, ɣletivi, kple dɔwɔɣiwo nu.
forClients.cards.1.0: Sɔ wo ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu do ŋgɔ na ɖoɖo
forClients.cards.1.1: Kpɔ profailwo, asiwo, ŋuɖoɖowo, fotowo, kple dɔwo.
forClients.cards.2.1: Bia nyawo, ɖo kpe nyawo dzi, eye naɖo asi ƒe nyatakakawo ɖe ɖoɖo nu.
forClients.cards.3.1: Zã ŋuɖoɖowo, nya ɖeɖe, mɔtutu, kple akɔnta ƒe ɖoɖowo ne ele be.
phone.search: Dɔwo si te ɖe Oak Street ŋu
cookieConsent.title: Wò ɣaɣla ƒe tiatiawo
cookieConsent.body: Miezãa Google Analytics ƒe cookies be miase mɔ si dzi amewo va, eye miatrɔ SwapSpot nanyo wu. Ate ŋu axɔ alo agbe analytics cookies siwo mehiã o.
maintenance.text: SwapSpot le yiyim ɖe sɛvɛ yeyewo dzi. Ɣeyiɣi si dzi le abe gaƒoƒo ɖeka ene la, ge ɖe eme, nyaɣaɣla trɔtrɔ, kple akɔnta ƒe trɔtrɔwo mate ŋu awɔ dɔ o. Taflatse gado ŋu emegbe vie.
reset.title: Trɔ wò nyaɣaɣla
reset.intro: Tia nyaɣaɣla yeye, emegbe ge ɖe SwapSpot app la me kple wò imeil kple nyaɣaɣla yeye la.
reset.done: Wotrɔ wò nyaɣaɣla. Ʋu SwapSpot app la eye nage ɖe eme.
reset.invalid: Trɔtrɔ ƒe lɛŋk sia mesɔ o alo eƒe ɣeyiɣi wu enu. Bia yeye tso app la me.
reset.openLink: Ʋu trɔtrɔ ƒe lɛŋk la tso wò imeil me be nayi edzi.
reset.unavailable: Nyaɣaɣla trɔtrɔ mele site sia dzi o fifia.
